use-pbos.name: Use PBOs
use-pbos.description: Uses OpenGL Pixel Buffer Objects to significantly speed up texture loading. This option has no impact on devices that do not support PBOs.

merge-plists.name: Merge Candidate Sheets
merge-plists.description:
Replaces the spritesheet load behavior to be consistent with the <cy>Texture Loader</c> mod, by checking all search paths for the spritesheet and merging frames.

In simple terms, this means loading an outdated texture pack will not cause textures added in a recent GD update to be missing.
